underrepresentation.note: The matrix is complete but not balanced. Figshare is Understand-heavy, so Understand→* cells are larger than Create→* and Analyze→Remember cells.

synthetic_caveats: Targets are deterministic task templates, not human-authored gold rewrites.
Topic extraction on long exam stems can leave awkward phrasing; cognitive task still changes.
A model could memorize templates. Absolute quality vs human exam writing is not established until human evaluation.
Relative 0.5B vs 1.5B comparison remains valid because both models see the identical split and prompt.
